name: Cement
description: Cement is a binding material commonly used to make concrete, mortar, screed, and other construction mixtures.
properties: Available in different grades and types
advantages: Strong when properly mixed and cured
Can be combined with other materials
considerations: Must be stored away from moisture

name: Concrete
description: Concrete is a mixture commonly made from cement, water, sand, and coarse aggregate. It is widely used in construction.
properties: Can be formed into different shapes
advantages: Suitable for many types of construction
considerations: Heavy compared with some other materials

name: Sand
description: Sand is a fine aggregate used in many construction mixtures, including mortar, concrete, plaster, and screed.
considerations: The correct type should be selected for the intended use

name: Gravel
description: Gravel is a coarse aggregate commonly used in concrete and drainage applications.
considerations: Transport can be expensive because of its weight

name: Concrete Blocks
description: Concrete blocks are manufactured masonry units commonly used for walls, partitions, and other building work.
properties: Made mainly from cement and aggregates
advantages: Easy to use in wall construction

name: Bricks
description: Bricks are masonry units made from materials such as fired clay or concrete and are commonly used for walls and architectural features.
considerations: Mortar is required for traditional brickwork

name: Steel
description: Steel is a strong metal widely used in buildings for reinforcement, structural frames, roofing, and other construction applications.
properties: Can be shaped into many forms
considerations: Can corrode if not properly protected

name: Timber
description: Timber is wood prepared for construction and is used for structural, finishing, furniture, and temporary construction applications.
properties: Available in different species and grades
advantages: Can be renewable when responsibly sourced
Useful for both construction and finishing
considerations: Quality varies between species and grades

name: Roofing Sheets
description: Roofing sheets are manufactured panels used to protect buildings from rain, sunlight, and other weather conditions.
properties: Lightweight compared with some roofing systems
advantages: Many styles and finishes are available
considerations: Some types can be noisy during heavy rain
Quality and thickness vary between products

name: Glass
description: Glass is a transparent or translucent material commonly used for windows, doors, partitions, and decorative applications.
properties: Can be specially treated for different applications
advantages: Easy to clean when properly installed
considerations: Different applications require appropriate glass types

name: Ceramic Tiles
description: Ceramic tiles are manufactured surfaces commonly used on floors, walls, bathrooms, kitchens, and other interior spaces.
properties: Available in many colors and patterns
considerations: Some surfaces can become slippery when wet
Requires a suitable adhesive or mortar

name: Paint
description: Paint is a finishing material applied to walls, ceilings, wood, metal, and other surfaces for protection and decoration.
properties: Different formulations are made for different surfaces
advantages: Many colors and finishes are available
considerations: Different surfaces may require different paints
Paint should be used in a well-ventilated area

name: Plaster
description: Plaster is a material used to create a smoother and more finished surface on walls and ceilings.
properties: Can be applied by hand or with suitable equipment
Can be finished in different textures
advantages: Provides a suitable surface for painting
considerations: Drying time depends on the material and conditions

name: Gypsum Board
description: Gypsum board is a manufactured panel commonly used for interior walls, ceilings, partitions, and other dry construction applications.
advantages: Easy to work with using suitable tools
considerations: Standard boards are not suitable for every wet location
Panels can be damaged by impact
Correct framing and installation are important

name: Aluminum
description: Aluminum is a lightweight metal commonly used for windows, doors, roofing components, frames, and other building applications.
properties: Can be formed into different shapes
considerations: Can be more expensive than some alternatives

name: Natural Stone
description: Natural stone is a durable building material used for walls, floors, landscaping, cladding, and decorative features.
properties: Natural variation in color and texture
advantages: Can add value and character to a building
considerations: Some stones require sealing or special maintenance

name: Insulation
description: Insulation materials are used to reduce heat transfer and can help improve the comfort and energy performance of a building.
properties: Different materials have different thermal properties
Can be installed in walls, ceilings, or roofs
advantages: Useful in different parts of a building
considerations: The appropriate material depends on the application

name: Waterproofing Materials
description: Waterproofing materials are used to reduce the movement of water into areas of a building that need protection from moisture.
considerations: The correct system should be selected for the location
